functions.name: SetSensingUpdatesEnabled
functions.docs: Enables or disables sensing updates. The timer is reset in either case.

functions.name: SetPeripheralVisionAngle
functions.docs: Sets PeripheralVisionAngle. Calculates PeripheralVisionCosine from PeripheralVisionAngle

functions.name: IsSensorActor
functions.docs: Is the given actor our owner? Used to ensure that we are not trying to sense our self / our owner.

functions.name: CanSenseAnything
functions.docs: Are we capable of sensing anything (and do we have any callbacks that care about sensing)? If so UpdateAISensing() will be called every sensing interval.

functions.name: ShouldCheckVisibilityOf
functions.docs: Returns true if we should check whether the given Pawn is visible (because we can see things, the Pawn is not hidden, and if the Pawn is a player and we only see players)

functions.name: CouldSeePawn
ShouldCheckAudibilityOf
functions.docs: Returns true if we should check whether we can hear the given Pawn (because we are able to hear, and the Pawn has the correct team relationship to us)

functions.name: HasLineOfSightTo
IsNoiseRelevant
functions.signature: IsNoiseRelevant(Target, Pawn, Noise Emitter Component, Source Within Noise Emitter)
functions.docs:
Test whether the noise is loud enough and recent enough to care about.  bSourceWithinNoiseEmitter is true iff the
noise was made by the pawn itself or within close proximity (its collision volume).  Otherwise the noise was made
at significant distance from the pawn.

functions.name: CanHear
functions.signature: CanHear(Target, Noise Loc, Loudness, Failed LOS)
functions.docs: @Returns true if sensor can hear this noise. Only executed if the noise has been determined to be relevant (via IsNoiseRelevant)

functions.name: GetSensorLocation
functions.docs: Get position where hearing/seeing occurs (i.e. ear/eye position).  If we ever need different positions for hearing/seeing, we'll deal with that then!

functions.name: GetSensorRotation
functions.docs: Get the rotation of this sensor. We need this for the sight component
